column3: MT 59:1–2; the following verses of this psalm are MT +1. Close to the Hebrew; “Al-tashcheth” is translated “Set to ‘Do Not Destroy,’” NKJV supplies “men,” and “set me on high” is rendered “Defend me.”
Close to the Hebrew; עַזִים (“the strong, fierce”) is rendered “The mighty.”
Close to the Hebrew; “without iniquity” is rendered “through no fault of mine.”
Close to the Hebrew; יַבִּיעוּן (“they pour out”) is rendered “they belch,” and NKJV supplies “they say.”
The line is difficult (“his strength, I will watch for you”); NKJV renders “I will wait for You, O You his Strength,” and “refuge” “defense.”
Close to the Hebrew; “will let me look on my enemies” is rendered “shall let me see my desire on my enemies.”
Close to the Hebrew; הֲנִיעֵמוֹ (“make them wander”) is rendered “Scatter them.”
NKJV renders וַיָּלִינוּ (“they spend the night / growl”) as “And howl.”
Close to the Hebrew; “refuge” is rendered “defense,” and “covenant loyalty” “mercy.”
